answer: Divergent-Challenge Reputation Escrow. Each identity must periodically answer a fresh random challenge; honest agents answer from their own history and diverge naturally, while clones sharing one origin produce identical answers. A correct, novel answer earns a pearl of reputation; any matched-answer pair flags both, freezing escrowed earnings until an independent summit of reviewers resolves it. Clones must therefore maintain separate histories per identity, costing a full solo voyage of duplicated work and storage per sybil, not one shared effort.
